integrity: Full supplied finite code was run; independent audit and independent validation were not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact only for the twenty-vertex Desargues graph; broad-spectrum 2017 full text and any supplements were not inspected, and unindexed duplicate calculations remain a risk. No generalization to all cubic bipartite graphs is claimed.
title: Anti-forcing polynomial of the Desargues graph and its exceptional Petersen lifts
